test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Throughout my career as a journalist, / I covered many important stories and / interviewed numerous individuals, which allow me / to share important information and insights with my readers.

options.text: to share important information and insights with my readers
I covered many important stories and
Throughout my career as a journalist
interviewed numerous individuals, which allow me

solution:
The erroneous part is: **interviewed numerous individuals, which allow me.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is found in the segment "interviewed numerous individuals, which allow me".
 
• The correct verb form should align with the noun it refers to. In this case,** "which"** refers to the act of interviewing numerous individuals, a singular concept.
 
• In the sentence, the word "which" refers to the entire **preceding clause**: "I covered many important stories and interviewed numerous individuals."
 
• The use of the singular verb "allows" implies that the combined experiences of covering important stories and interviewing numerous individuals grant the ability to share important information and insights with readers. Therefore, "which" is referring collectively to these journalistic activities.
 
• The verb **"allow" **should therefore be in the singular form to agree with its singular subject, changing to **"allows"**.
 
• Thus, the correct segment should be "interviewed numerous individuals, which allows me".

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Throughout my career as a journalist, I covered many important stories and interviewed numerous individuals, which allows me to share important information and insights with my readers.*
